name: victorian
summary:
A reviewer who was NOT told what it is would call it: "Victorian house with turret".
What they saw: roof Mixed with overhang; massing Varied; wall depth Deep; street windows NineOrMore; props Few; wall gaps None.
Look: colour harmony Mixed, colour interest High, form interest High, detail finesse High, something looks out of place.
Measured: 10 visible materials, 0 blank walls, 0 stray blocks, 12% stairs, 4.0% fences/walls/trapdoors.

The person you are building for would most want, in order:
1. keep to fewer colour families
2. add small details a player notices (lanterns, planters, signs, awnings)
3. add visible age where the style allows it (patina, worn or mixed blocks) (they said of a build they preferred: "More interesting textures")

Keep what already works: the wall relief, the massing, the lively colours.
Use your judgement: skip any item that doesn't suit the style of the building.
